title: nf-core/gwas pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input. One row is one analysis unit: a single cohort paired with a single trait.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis unit. Used as the focal identifier in every output path and filename.
analysis_id.errorMessage: Analysis ID must be provided, must be unique across the samplesheet and cannot contain spaces

cohort_id.description: Identifier of the cohort these genotypes belong to. Rows sharing a cohort ID must declare the same genotype source.
cohort_id.errorMessage: Cohort ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

trait_id.description: Identifier of the trait under analysis. Several traits may share one cohort ID.
trait_id.errorMessage: Trait ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

trait_type.description: Declared type of the trait. Never inferred from the phenotype values.
trait_type.errorMessage: Trait type must be one of 'quantitative' or 'binary'

genome_build.description: Genome build the genotypes are on. Build-keyed reference resources are selected from this value.
genome_build.errorMessage: Genome build must be one of 'GRCh37' or 'GRCh38'

ancestry.description: Free-text ancestry label carried through to output provenance.

pgen.description: PLINK 2 genotype file. Supply together with 'pvar' and 'psam' and leave the other two genotype groups empty.
pgen.errorMessage: PLINK 2 genotype file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.pgen'

pvar.errorMessage: PLINK 2 variant file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.pvar' or '.pvar.zst'

psam.errorMessage: PLINK 2 sample file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.psam'

bed.description: PLINK 1 genotype file. Supply together with 'bim' and 'fam' and leave the other two genotype groups empty.
bed.errorMessage: PLINK 1 genotype file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.bed'

bim.errorMessage: PLINK 1 variant file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.bim'

fam.errorMessage: PLINK 1 sample file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.fam'

vcf.description: VCF genotype file. Leave the two PLINK genotype groups empty when this is supplied.
vcf.errorMessage: VCF file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.vcf', '.vcf.gz' or '.vcf.bgz'

vcf_index.description: Optional index for 'vcf'. Declared for completeness; the pipeline converts the VCF itself and does not read the index.
vcf_index.errorMessage: VCF index cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.tbi' or '.csi'

pheno_file.description: Headered phenotype file containing the trait column named by 'pheno_col'.
pheno_file.errorMessage: Phenotype file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must exist

pheno_col.description: Name of the column in 'pheno_file' holding this trait. Always named explicitly, even when the file has a single trait column.
pheno_col.errorMessage: Phenotype column must be provided and cannot contain spaces

case_value.description: Value used for cases in 'pheno_file'. Carried as a string, so numeric conventions such as PLINK's 2 and textual ones such as 'Case' are both accepted. Required on binary rows, rejected on quantitative rows.
case_value.errorMessage: Case value must be a single token without spaces, for example '2' or 'Case'

control_value.description: Value used for controls in 'pheno_file'. Carried as a string, so numeric conventions such as PLINK's 1 and textual ones such as 'Control' are both accepted. Required on binary rows, rejected on quantitative rows.
control_value.errorMessage: Control value must be a single token without spaces, for example '1' or 'Control'

qcovar_file.description: Optional headered file of quantitative covariates.
qcovar_file.errorMessage: Quantitative covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist

covar_file.description: Optional headered file of categorical covariates.
covar_file.errorMessage: Categorical covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist

association_methods.errorMessage: Association methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

heritability_methods.errorMessage: Heritability methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

population_prevalence.description: Population prevalence of a binary trait, used to report heritability on the liability scale.
population_prevalence.errorMessage: Population prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1

sample_prevalence.description: Case proportion in the analysed sample, used to correct ascertainment on the liability scale.
sample_prevalence.errorMessage: Sample prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1

ldak_model.description: Kinship model used by the LDAK routes. 'ldak' weights predictors, 'gcta' ignores weights.
ldak_model.errorMessage: LDAK model must be one of 'ldak' or 'gcta'

ldak_power.description: Power applied to predictor variances when LDAK builds its kinship matrix.
ldak_power.errorMessage: LDAK power must be a number between -2 and 0

ldak_relatedness_filter.description: Restrict the LDAK heritability estimator for this analysis to an unrelated subset. Does not change the shared kinship matrix.
ldak_relatedness_filter.errorMessage: LDAK relatedness filter must be 'true' or 'false'

kvik_subset.description: How LDAK-KVIK selects its step 1 predictor subset: every predictor, a thinned common set, or the list in 'kvik_extract_file'.
kvik_subset.errorMessage: KVIK subset must be one of 'all', 'thin_common' or 'provided'

kvik_extract_file.description: Predictor list used for LDAK-KVIK step 1. Only accepted when 'kvik_subset' is 'provided'.
kvik_extract_file.errorMessage: KVIK extract file cannot contain spaces and must exist

gcta_grm_parts.description: Number of parts GCTA splits its relatedness matrix build into. A memory control, not a scientific setting.
gcta_grm_parts.errorMessage: GCTA relatedness matrix part count must be an integer of 1 or more

ldms_maf_edges.description: Semicolon-delimited minor allele frequency bin edges for GCTA GREML-LDMS. Semicolons are used because commas already delimit the method selector lists.
ldms_maf_edges.errorMessage: MAF edges must be a semicolon-delimited list of numbers, for example '0.01;0.1;0.2;0.5'
